analysis.investment_thesis: At P/E 73 and P/B 10.9, this aerospace microcap offers zero margin of safety against Graham's quantitative filters. Compounding the price problem, free cash flow has been negative for three consecutive years (-29, -43, -8 Cr), meaning the reported earnings are not translating into cash.
key_strengths: Revenue and net profit compounding ~45% over 3 years (2022→2025)
ROCE of 23.65% indicates efficient capital deployment on paper
Debt reduced from 46 Cr (2023) to 21 Cr (2025); promoter stake high at 68%
key_risks: P/E 73 and P/B 10.9 — pricing assumes perpetual 45% growth with no cushion
Operating cash flow negative in 3 of last 4 years; FCF cumulatively negative ~80 Cr
Cash collapsed from 17 Cr to 3 Cr in one year — working capital stress
red_flags: Earnings quality poor: Net profit 24 Cr vs OCF -3 Cr in FY25
P/B >10x — paying a decade of book value for a 16% ROE
Equity jumped from 25 to 126 Cr in FY24 suggesting dilutive equity raise baked into price
analysis.detailed_analysis:
From the standpoint of Security Analysis, this stock fails nearly every quantitative gate. The Graham Number requires price < sqrt(22.5 × EPS × BVPS). With earnings yield of ~1.4% (P/E 73) and book value ~1/11th of price, the intrinsic-value test is violated by an order of magnitude. A rational investor does not pay 73 years of current earnings for a 1,516 Cr defense microcap regardless of the growth narrative — Mr. Market is clearly infatuated with the "Aerospace & Defense" label.

More troubling than valuation is the divergence between reported profit and cash. Net profit aggregated ~51 Cr over 2023-2025, yet operating cash flow was cumulatively -39 Cr over the same period, and free cash flow was -80 Cr. The business is funded by financing inflows (+85 Cr in 2023-2024), not self-generated cash. Cash on the balance sheet fell from 17 Cr to 3 Cr in a single year while debt remains at 21 Cr — the current ratio and interest coverage deserve scrutiny I cannot perform from this data alone. This is precisely the speculative growth profile Graham warned against: accounting earnings unsupported by cash, priced for flawless execution. Avoid.
